description: The content-shaped groups (ATLAS_FRAME_GROUPS, docs/ATLAS-LOD.md) rendered offline by atlas_render from the real exports, against atlas_truth (vsTruth in the report) and the live capture (the twin)

scenes.title: Groups vs the exact reference to 1 km: the export's sections as the game feeds them, the live capture's camera
scenes.note: report.vsTruth: dE by distance band against atlas_truth's frame of the same camera (4 jittered samples a pixel each, the groups' dither averaged as the pack's TAA averages it); shade=mc draws the texel colours with vanilla's face shade, so the remaining difference is the representation plus what vanilla adds (smooth light, the lightmap under roofs and crowns); the harness's own liveDEByBand compares with the live vanilla picture, whose far bands are today's far field

scenes.title: The same view through today's voxel path (groups=0): the baseline the groups are measured against
scenes.note: the old path over the same materials (palette colour per block, no shapes): the groups' gain is the difference between the two reports' vsTruth

scenes.title: Groups to the horizon on Vulkan at 1920x1080: Falkreath's real sections over the preview terrain, frame time and memory
scenes.note: report: frameMs (fastest of 32, GPU timestamps) and frameMedianMs, groups.bytes / maxRegionBytes (memory), groupsBuildMs (every tree of the clipmap, all threads), buildMs (the voxel path's regions); skipped while the GPU is busy
